player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I used the letter "a" four times in the first stanza ("alone", "a", "dawn", "lane", "and", "pain", "plan"). I should have counted the letter "a" before writing each line to ensure the total count never exceeded one. Next time, I will write the entire song in my head or on scratchpad first, strictly limiting the single "a" to a specific word (like "a" or "Layton") and avoiding it in all other lines, then generate the full lyrics only after confirming the constraint is met.
